description.value: A modern aquatic and community centre operated by the City of New Westminster, opened in April 2024. Its name, təməsew̓txʷ (Sea Otter House), reflects the city's commitment to Indigenous reconciliation. The three-storey facility with its distinctive sawtooth roof serves as a recreation and community hub in New Westminster's downtown area.
